features: Hybrid Instant Camera and Smartphone Printer with Premium Sand Beige Textured Finish

Features dual cameras - main and wide-angle selfie camera - to combine two images together into one photo using layered photo mode. Additional features include automatic timer - 2 and 10 seconds, multiple creative modes, auto exposure and flash control, and a USB Type-C charging port
Sound recording features with instax sound printing feature. Create custom animated videos with your images, sound, backgrounds and background music using instax sound album feature
3" LCD monitor on the back of the camera for editing before printing. Print smartphone photos via Bluetooth via instax mini LiPlay app
Requires instax mini instant screen protector (sold separately)
description: Capture your adventures and share them with meaning with the instax mini LiPlay+TM Hybrid Instant Camera. As well as being an instant camera and smartphone printer, this versatile 2-in-1 hybrid instant camera features dual cameras (a main camera plus a wide-angle selfie camera) and multiple sound features (think voice messages, laughs and environmental sounds). Adding emotional depth and intentional creativity to every photo is easy, whether visual or audio! Selfies have never been this easy thanks to the LCD monitor! And to give you even more creativity, the instax mini LiPlay+ Hybrid Instant Camera features layered photo mode, which lets you combine two images from the main camera and selfie, instax-Rich modeTM and instax-Natural modeTM camera for when you want to play with colors, as well as a selection of art filters. To keep your vision flowing, your photos can also speak a lot. With instax Sound PrintTM feature, you have four unique ways to record 3-second audio clips to add to your images, then listen back by scanning the QR code* printed into your photo with your smartphone. Alternatively, the instax Sound AlbumTM feature turns your adventures into personalized animated vid
